Detalle de la especificación: General Transit Feed Specification
tags: Consorcio Regional de Transportes de Madrid

method.decoder: Python standard library protobuf wire decoder; fields checked against current GtfsRtModels.cs; FeedHeader.timestamp=3, VehiclePosition.position=2, VehiclePosition.vehicle=8.
method.static: ZIP CSV via csv.DictReader; headers and values trimmed, as in current loader. First trip shape checked for each route plus actual sampled trip shape references. Calendar evaluated for Saturday 2026-10-24.
method.freshness: Ages measured at request start, not completed receipt; network latency excluded. No sustained cadence or long-term identity certification claimed.
method.scope: Madrid determined by exact realtime trip_id join to static trips, then inspected Madrid route_id namespace 10. route_type=2 retained for rail-only candidate; route_type=3 excluded.
